framing_question: How does the timing and assumed local capture of a fixed CAD 50 billion Alberta AI-infrastructure program change the graph's structural pressure ordering?

variants.label: Staggered reference
variants.decision_question: What does the existing ten-year ramp imply under the locked structural assumptions?

variants.label: Front-loaded
variants.decision_question: Which trades and schedules tighten when 67% of capex is concentrated in 2027-2031?
variants.declared_change: Timing only; total, component mix, denominators and 72% local capture are unchanged.

variants.label: Constrained delivery
variants.decision_question: How does spreading the same program to 2041 change peak structural pressure?
variants.declared_change: Timing only; the fifteen-year profile is capped at a 7.5% annual share.

variants.label: High local capture
variants.decision_question: How much does structural pressure change if 90% of modelled construction activity is retained in Alberta?
variants.declared_change: Local capture only; total, component mix, denominators and timing are unchanged.

publication_boundary.reason: The variants deliberately change declared assumptions to stress-test timing and local capture. Their pressure scores are dimensionless graph diagnostics, not probabilities, percentages, forecasts, cost escalation, schedule delay or power requirements.
